plan.notes: Source: official Maricopa pathway-map page (https://www.riosalado.edu/degrees-certificates/behavioral-science-and-human-services/search-warrant-preparation-5220n-ccl). Effective Term Fall 2021; catalog_year 2021-2022 derived from Effective Term. Only a part-time sequence is published on the official page (no full-time sequence); the published part-time sequence is used verbatim. Sequence reflects the page's DEFAULT base pathway-map view (option-specific rows are hidden until a pathway option is selected). Credit ranges (e.g. '1-3') use the lower bound, per collection convention; 'X or Y' choices use the first-listed option's credits. Category mapping: core = AGEC/program area value present; major = no area value; elective = restricted/general-elective placeholders. Choices flagged choice=true.
